regime.label: Protection zone with the long-gamma cushion 80% gone - dampened upside, accelerant downside
evidence: +673 net GEX in the +/-1.5% band around 1065.4, down 80% from +3,318 on 26 Aug; total chain GEX fell 64% to +2,019.

1107.2 gamma flip now sits 41.8 points above spot versus a 21.0-point gap on 26 Aug, while the 1030-1060 strikes below spot carry -5,122 net GEX - a break under 1050 puts dealers in amplifying territory.
+1,894 contracts of net OI added (puts +1,247 to 41,032, calls +647 to 19,152) with 25D skew steepening to +1.56 from +0.88 - insurance is being built, not unwound.
451 lots churned the 1100 call for just +6 net OI, so the headline wall is not being reinforced; the live resistance is +506 OI built across 1070/1080/1090 on 1,020 lots.

S50U26.today_summary: 1065.4 closed down 5.1 points, 5.4 above the 1060 max pain that just drifted down from 1070 after nine sessions anchored there. Net dealer gamma in the +/-1.5% band around spot collapsed 80% to +673 while the gamma flip rose to 1107.2, leaving spot 41.8 points below it. Put OI grew +1,247 to 41,032 against +647 calls, steepening 25D skew to +1.56 - protection demand rather than capitulation. Call volume outpaced puts for the first time in the window at 0.89 P/C, but 451 of those lots churned the 1100 strike for only +6 net OI.
what_changed: Max pain moved to 1060 from 1070 - the first drift after nine sessions anchored there, now 5.4 points below spot.
ATM-zone net GEX collapsed 80% to +673 from +3,318 and total chain GEX fell 64% to +2,019 - the cushion around spot is largely gone.
Gamma flip rose to 1107.2 from 1096.3 while spot fell 9.9 points, doubling the spot-to-flip gap to 41.8 points.
Data note: this is Friday 2026-08-28's close stamped 2026-08-29 by the TFEX feed clock (scrape ran Saturday 07:28); the 2026-08-27 session was lost, so every delta here spans two sessions.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Max pain held 1070 from 17 Aug through 26 Aug and has now broken to 1060, conceding ground to a spot that fell 19.8 points from 1085.2 on 17 Aug to 1065.4. The dealer cushion eroded over the same window: ATM-zone GEX ran +3,218 (21 Aug), +2,267 (24 Aug), +2,205 (25 Aug), +3,318 (26 Aug), then +673 now. The gamma flip drifted up 1095.6 to 1107.2 while spot drifted down, so the long-gamma dampening zone moved further out of reach instead of following price. Put OI climbed every session from 37,537 (21 Aug) to 41,032, with fresh tail buying at 950/960 (+577 combined) and 25D skew re-steepening from +0.13 (25 Aug) to +1.56. ATM IV is net unchanged at 12.97 to 13.44, so this is positioning drift rather than a volatility event.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050/1020
strategies.rationale: Protection zone with -5,122 net GEX stacked at 1030-1060 means a break under the live 1050 support (1,806 OI, +143 on 272 lots) is amplified by dealer hedging, so this buys the accelerant as defined-risk insurance instead of selling into it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 6.3 points net debit (1050 put 11.6 ask less 1020 put 5.3 bid); max value 30 points; breakeven 1043.7.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1080, where +2,736 net GEX resumes dampening.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1090/1110
strategies.rationale: The 1080-1100 block carries +7,043 net GEX that fades rallies, and the 1100 wall churned 451 lots for +6 OI - intact but unreinforced; the 1090 call prices a 0.236 delta against that dampening.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20 wing width less 3.7 net credit = 16.3 points; breakeven 1093.7. Short-vol payoff is negative-skew, so size small.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1100 on genuine call OI growth rather than churn.

strategies.name: Put spread 1050/1020 financed by the 1090/1110 call spread
strategies.rationale: Expresses the GEX asymmetry directly - the dampened upside pays for the accelerant downside - assembling both legos into one defined-risk structure at a 2.6-point net debit.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 22.6 points if settlement is at or above 1110 (20 call-spread width plus 6.3 put debit less 3.7 call credit); max gain 27.4 points below 1020.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1100 - the short call spread then dominates the risk and the put wing is dead.

S50U26.prediction: 1065.4 sits 5.4 points above the 1060 max pain and 41.8 below the 1107.2 gamma flip, so the base case is chop between live 1050 put support and the 1070-1090 call band that absorbed +506 OI, with a 9.02-point 1-sigma daily range. The asymmetry is the trade-relevant read: rallies meet +7,043 of dampening GEX at 1080-1100, while a break below 1050 enters a -5,122 short-gamma pocket where dealer hedging amplifies the move. A close below 1050 invalidates the range read and turns the structure directional; a close above 1090 invalidates the capped-upside read.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no execution is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks - treat the 1060 max pain as a tendency, not a magnet. Defined-risk is not risk-free: the 6.3-, 16.3- and 22.6-point max losses are real, and short-vol payoffs are negative-skew. Data caveat: the 2026-08-27 session is missing from the record, so all cross-day deltas span two sessions.
